triggers: the 'Pattern: setmaxregister Register Reallocation' technique is being considered on NVIDIA Hopper (H20 / H100 / H200 / SM90)

payload.goal: Optimization technique for NVIDIA Hopper (H20 / H100 / H200 / SM90): Pattern: setmaxregister Register Reallocation

problem.statement: Warp Specialization -- Pattern: setmaxregister Register Reallocation

payload.what: **Practical Experience**: - Hopper allows dynamic adjustment of the register limit per warp at runtime - DMA warps only perform address computation and TMA instructions; 32 registers are sufficient - MMA warps need to store accumulators and intermediate results; 256 registers reduce spilling - This is a Hopper-exclusive feature; Ampere does not support it
payload.when: **Practical Experience**: - Hopper allows dynamic adjustment of the register limit per warp at runtime - DMA warps only perform address computation and TMA instructions; 32 registers are sufficient - MMA warps need to store accumulators an…

implementation.snippet:
```python
# DMA warp doesn't need many registers → give them to MMA warp
if warp_group_id == 0:  # DMA warp
    cute.arch.setmaxregister(32)   # limit to 32 registers
else:  # MMA warp
    cute.arch.setmaxregister(256)  # use more registers
```
